summary.zh: 按 10 分钟到每月定时跑实验
summary.en: Run an experiment loop on a schedule, from 10 minutes up.

description.zh: 为一个已配置好的实验启动定时循环，按选定间隔自动执行并记录每轮结果，也可以随时停止。间隔从 10 分钟到每月不等。需要实验已经建好，并且存在可运行的评测命令。
description.en: Starts a scheduled loop for an existing experiment, running iterations at a chosen interval and recording each result; stop it any time. Intervals range from 10 minutes to monthly. The experiment needs a working eval command.
